scope: PR #87 reader footer and section controls
renderer: plain HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript
rationale: vidux-browse is a Python http.server app with static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
the repo has VitePress and Vue only for docs, not for the browser app
adding React and Storybook would introduce a new build stack before the reader player needs component reuse
reconsiderWhen: reader controls are reused outside vidux-browse
the player gains enough independent interaction states that static fixtures stop catching regressions
vidux-browse already has a bundler or React island for another committed feature

states.expectation: operator sees the exact local MLX server launch command
operator sees bounded health retry while the local server starts
operator sees confirmation after copying the launch command
operator sees server health / model prep progress
operator sees cached versus synthesizing segment progress
operator sees cached playback instead of regeneration
operator sees current-document cache clearing without losing the footer controls
operator sees stale cross-document cache eviction after playback starts
player exposes stop, progress, time, source, and speed
player shows paused state without losing current time
operator sees which segment failed and can retry
long section names truncate without layout breakage
player compresses at phone-width without overlap
annotation FAB and reader player do not collide
